question: The host-GL default costs frame time: a full render pass takes 33..43 ms through Windows' generic opengl32 (single-threaded) against 6..12 ms for GlRaster with its 4 workers (20_pass_times.log); the app's frames with terrain passes rose from median 19 / max 40 ms (S3.9, GlRaster) to median 45 / max 95 ms, and test_app_ingame::test_terrain_pass_frames_fit_the_frame read RED once in three runs (frame 144, 2 passes, 95 ms work). Whether host GL drawing horizontal bands on several contexts (glScissor per band, one DIB each) gives the same pixels, and so the frame budget back, is not measured.

Two runs with several host-GL contexts on worker threads never ended (glband c7 z2_r3 once; a framegate boot of sandbox_basic with WglBands N = 4): the spinning thread sat in opengl32.dll 10.0.26100.9278 at +0x13d5..+0x13db, a mask-bit scan that never ends when the mask in ecx is 0. What passes it a zero mask, and whether parallel contexts cause it, is not measured; 24 stress runs (720 band contexts, concurrent and serialised creation) did not hang.
